description: Captain's Log — one curated suppressed document + one modern replication idea, weekly. [prescribed: Master Directive D — capture is subtle and high-value]

suppressed_doc.title: D. C. Miller's 1933 Cosmic Ether Model
suppressed_doc.why: Dayton Miller's ether-drift measurements are the strongest documented counter-evidence to the 'null result' that killed aether physics — and they were quietly set aside. A clean modern re-measurement is the single most decisive experiment the archive's central wrong turn could retry.

modern_replication.title: Revisit Miller's drift with a ring-laser or high-precision fiber interferometer
modern_replication.idea: Miller's apparatus and raw data are documented. A modern interferometer (orders of magnitude more sensitive than his 1933 setup) could settle whether the small persistent drift he measured was real or apparatus artifact — with instruments he never had.
